verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents real-time co-editing of documents, sheets, or slides in the browser, either natively or through a documented Office integration. The REST and Graph file CRUD docs are developer building blocks, not in-place collaborative editing. Community remarks about opening files in the browser do not describe co-editing.

support.subject: As an operations lead, documents are editable in place — real-time co-editing of docs/sheets/slides in the browser, native or via a documented integration
